title: A Must-See Flamenco Experience in Seville
text: The show is a must-see when visiting Seville. If you want to experience a taste of Spanish culture and the passion of flamenco, I highly recommend it. The performances are superb, with a variety of styles that keep the show engaging from beginning to end. The venue is also air-conditioned, which makes it especially enjoyable in August, when it offers a welcome escape from the baking heat outside.

title: Worth the extra time needed.

title: A show that is simply magical.
text: A show that is simply magical. Energy, grace. Thanks to the 6 artists on stage who really live their show, and give a lot. We visited the museum during the day, before the show: this allows us to have a light when we do not know flamenco.
author: 000PatM

title: Wow! Go see this show!!!
text: I highly recommend this show to anyone who wants to watch authentic Flamenco! It was an hour or fabulous flamenco! There isn’t a bad seat in the house.  It’s actually quite nice that it takes place in a small setting. You really get a feel for the music and dancers. I wish I could say more! It’s worth every penny!
author: Nycxmad

title: Spectacular show very powerful a must see
text: Spectacular show very powerful. The dancers were incredible and the musicians/singers made the whole thing hugely emotional. Turn up early to choose your seats - we managed front row and could feel every swish of the shawls. Drinks very reasonably priced. Lasted about an hour. Would recommend to everyone.
author: Pamela_M
